MemoriaHub CLI v1.4.0
Usage: memoriahub node [options] [command]

Run this machine as a worker node that processes the enrichment queue

Options:
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  register [options]      Register this machine as a worker node
  enroll [options]        Log in and mint a durable node credential, storing it
                          as this CLI's token (enrollment without hand-copying a
                          soon-to-expire PAT)
  start [options]         Run the worker-node loop (claim → compute → submit)
  stop                    Stop a running worker node (IPC → SIGTERM →
                          server-side deregister)
  status                  Show this machine's node config and current
                          capabilities
  logs [options]          Print (or tail) the worker-node JSONL log
  set-concurrency <n>     Adjust worker concurrency — live via IPC when running,
                          else saved to config
  heap-snapshot           Write a V8 heap snapshot from the running worker
                          daemon (memory-leak diagnosis)
  service                 Manage the systemd user service that keeps the worker
                          node always on
  list                    List registered worker nodes (best-effort)
  doctor                  Diagnose worker-node capabilities, connectivity, and
                          models
  install-deps [options]  Install every dependency this machine needs to become
                          a worker node (ffmpeg, native compute libraries,
                          tesseract OCR data, Docker + compreface-core) — Linux
                          only
  help [command]          display help for command
